verdict.rationale: Muse lets you personalize your one agent: name it, give it an avatar, and shape how it talks. Side chats give separate context per topic. Neither is building multiple custom assistants with their own instructions and knowledge, and nothing in the evidence shows sharing assistants with others. These are adjacent personalization features, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can build and share custom assistants with their own instructions and knowledge
